name: Cascader-Shadcn
summary: Cascading dropdown component for shadcn/ui that selects hierarchical data such as locations, categories or organizational structures.
description: A cascading menu component for forms that selects values from nested options with click or hover expansion. It supports icons, custom labels, custom display rendering, per-option or whole-component disabling, placeholder and clear controls; installs with the shadcn CLI or by copying Cascader.tsx. Inspired by the Cascader components of Ant Design and React Suite; MIT licensed.
contains: hierarchical cascading menu with click or hover expansion
icons, custom labels and custom display render
disable per option or the whole component
